build_trainer_init: build a Trainer instance by calling init_fn to set up the HMR model, SMPL body model, optimizer, and loss criteria
run_train_step: run a single training step on an input batch to predict SMPL pose, shape, and camera parameters with backpropagation
run_train_exemplar_step: run an exemplar training step that uses 2D keypoint loss and beta regularization instead of full 3D loss
test_evaluation: test the trained model on a dataset by calling test with a dataset name to get MPJPE and reconstruction error
refactor_weakProjection_gpu: refactor the weakProjection_gpu function to project 3D skeleton joints to 2D using scale and translation parameters
